lookup_md5sum_for_dataset_file: look up the expected MD5 checksum for a MetaICL preprocessing dataset TSV file by name
verify_dataset_file_integrity: verify the integrity of a downloaded MetaICL dataset TSV file by comparing its MD5 against the expected checksum
list_all_md5sum_entries: list all dataset file names and their expected MD5 checksums from the MD5SUM dictionary
check_missing_checksums: check whether a given dataset TSV file has a corresponding entry in the MD5SUM lookup table
validate_batch_of_files: validate a batch of MetaICL dataset files by checking each file's MD5 against the MD5SUM dictionary
